name: spc-tests
description: Local-only tests: Firestore rules + full app run against the Firebase emulators. Never touches the live project.

scripts.test:rules: npm run sync-rules && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-spc "node rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:app: npm run sync-rules && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project fireacademy1-c8ef2 "node e2e.cjs"
scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:app
